scene: Upstairs, the open-air rooftop station offers three routes away.
picture: Along the rooftop dock, the elderly bearded player in his blue cap and orange cardigan leans on his cane facing forward. On the left waits a red funicular carriage on sloped tracks. In the centre, a robotic frog sits atop a yellow rickshaw. On the right, a blue striped water taxi floats beside the deck.
shown: a red cable funicular car waiting with open door on the left
a mechanical frog seated on a yellow cycle rickshaw at the centre
a striped canal boat tied to a mooring ring on the right
